rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to an icy condition, which is a classic premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child suffered a broken wrist after slipping on ice on the policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bill reimbursement. This is a high-severity pediatric injury premises liability claim requiring prompt investigation and medical documentation review.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway; broke wrist
